latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — deep audit of Svelte and SvelteKit components for quality and best practices.

- Analyzes reactive statements, store usage, accessibility (WCAG), SSR compatibility, and rendering performance.
- Flags issues with array mutation, store design, large/unkeyed components, and accessibility violations.
- Highlights browser-only API usage for SSR safety.
- Outputs prioritized findings with fix recommendations.
- Designed for use in Svelte/SvelteKit project reviews and production readiness checks.
